title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — CONQUAS variant
description: CONQUAS-aligned variant of the SiteShrimp Photo Entry schema. Extends the base schema with the CONQUAS assessment zone and inspection lot, and tightens conquas_element to required. Field semantics follow the CONQUAS (Private Residential) R1 convention; 'Other' is excluded from conquas_element under this variant since CONQUAS scoring is restricted to the seven Internal Finishes elements.
x-csv-header-convention: Each property maps 1:1 to a column in the Entries sheet. The 'x-csv-header' field is the exact column header string. Variant columns (Assessment Zone, Inspection Lot) are appended after the base columns when the project's workCategory is 'CONQUAS'.

conquas_element.description: CONQUAS Internal Finishes element. Required and restricted to the seven IF elements under this variant — 'Other' is not assessable for CONQUAS scoring.

assessment_zone.description: CONQUAS assessment category. Drives which scoring framework applies (CONQUAS-21 Architectural / Structural / M&E).

inspection_lot.description: Optional CONQUAS sample lot identifier. Groups photos belonging to the same scored sample for QP traceability and audit reconstruction.
